Unresolved first-party preset conflict: the configurator and product page default are 6% max / 9% target / 4% daily, while the E8 One help article calls 4% max / 6% target / 3% daily the preset. The rendered checkout configuration is used here.
Performance payout minimum: net payout share must exceed 50% of the daily drawdown. The general payout floor is $100.
Platforms: TradeLocker, MatchTrader, cTrader and MT5 depending on region/account type; US clients may use only TradeLocker or MatchTrader; cTrader adds $10 when the base account price is under $100.
Leverage: Forex 1:30, indices 1:15, metals 1:15 and crypto 1:1.

The dedicated E8PRO v2 page is used because it is the current product-specific purchase page and its checkout links carry the current E8PRO v2 configuration.

Current product-specific pages describe E8 Pro as fixed: 8% target, 8% static drawdown, 2.5% daily drawdown, 80% default payout, no consistency rule. The older custom-account article still lists 6/8/10% drawdown and 80/90/100% payout options; this conflict is not reconciled and no unrendered variant price is inferred.
A 2% daily profit cap applies in both Challenge and Performance; excess profit is not counted toward target or payout performance.
Daily payout exactness: one request per day after rollover, with at least 1% of initial balance in profit. payoutFirstDays remains null because E8 publishes no first-wait day count.
Each request first makes 50% of total profits requestable; the chosen 80% or 100% payout applies to that requestable half, and the rest remains as drawdown buffer.
Platforms: TradeLocker, MatchTrader, cTrader and MT5 depending on region/account type; US clients may use only TradeLocker or MatchTrader; cTrader adds $10 when the base account price is under $100.
Leverage: Forex 1:30, crypto 1:2 on the current E8PRO v2 page, indices 1:15, metals 1:15 and energies 1:15.

Tier-specific EOD drawdown is now represented as maxLossUsd: $1,000 on $25K, $2,000 on $50K, $3,000 on $100K and $4,500 on $150K. A single maxLossPct would be false because those equal 4%, 4%, 3% and 3%.
The Performance 2% Daily Pause stops trading until midnight but is not an account breach; dailyLossPct remains null because the challenge has no published hard daily cap.

Payout requirements include a 35% best-day rule, $100 minimum ($125 gross request at an 80% share), a non-withdrawable buffer equal to EOD drawdown and published per-cycle payout caps. Five profitable days of at least 0.3% realized PnL are required between later payouts, not for the first.
Platforms: TradeLocker, MatchTrader, cTrader and MT5 depending on region/account type; US clients may use only TradeLocker or MatchTrader.
